'''Cjaalysce'I''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. It had walls to prevent the winds of [[Jyalma]], the [[Socorran]] windy season, from destroying the city.
